policy.note: This is evaluator policy data, not a supported public plugin configuration schema.
policy.nestedOwnership: Every declaration authored in a recognized root sx tree uses the enclosing canonical component contract, regardless of selector target. A selector never proves a child/slot component identity. Explicit property allowances apply at all depths.

caseContract.source: Complete TSX parse input; lint cases are not rendered task components.
caseContract.expected.diagnostics: Exact unordered set for valid/invalid labels; null for uncertainty cases means record findings without prescribing a production rule result.
caseContract.expected.coverage: Evaluator-owned eligibility across analysis and semantic validation; supported, out-of-scope or unknown. This is not a public plugin coverage API.
caseContract.environment: Optional pristine evaluator inputs for custom configuration cases.
caseContract.expected.analysisStatus: Whether syntax and ownership are within the proposed readable surface; separate from policyStatus.
caseContract.expected.policyStatus: Independent policy outcome: accepted, violating or unknown. Unvalidated tokens and custom transforms do not become accepted through zero diagnostics.
caseContract.label: valid/invalid prescribe supported production-rule findings. unknown has no prescribed production findings; independentValidation may still establish accepted/violating policy for an out-of-scope channel.
caseContract.expected.diagnostics.sourceRange: Zero-based UTF-16 [start,end) range of the authored property key token, excluding colon; location expectations are reviewed independently. holdout-conditional-branch must report only the second color key.

conditions.B: A output corrected with the same guidance and project policy.
conditions.C: A output corrected with the same guidance, policy and diagnostics.

agentProtocol.executionOrder: Randomized B/C order within each independently generated pair.
agentProtocol.modelSelection: Only gpt-6.1-sol; pin provider model identifier and effort per run. Vary effort in separate cohorts, keeping identical model/effort for B and C within each pair. Record spend budget before paid execution. Use gpt-6.1-sol for any model-based visual judge; record judge effort separately and keep it fixed across candidate conditions.
agentProtocol.fixtureStatus: Fixture data, UI assertions and pinned guidance remain implementation work.
agentProtocol.stoppingRule: Primary B/C stop only when the hidden independent evaluator accepts the output or the shared three-round cap is reached. Observation tasks use one correction round each.
agentProtocol.sharedFeedback: B/C receive identical type/build/runtime errors and a generic acceptance-failed notice when needed; only C receives policy lint diagnostics. Oracle labels, rubric implementation and expected fixes stay outside prompts.
agentProtocol.familyReporting: Report Material/System and each of the four stable X families separately; no inference to licensed or preview components.
agentProtocol.adversarialWorkflow: Before promoting coverage, independently challenge ownership, channel semantics and acceptance. Add regression cases for each reproduced bypass. Failures reopen the specific gate; keep changed runs separate by manifest hash. Runtime mutation hiding required text/control through an allowed nested display property must fail task acceptance even when property-policy lint passes.
agentProtocol.channelAcceptance: Resolve dedicated channels only through declared pristine independent assertions. Report production analysis coverage separately; approved dedicated axis styling may be task-accepted without being counted as production sx coverage.

tasks.prompt: Build an account form with labeled name and email inputs, Save and Cancel actions, and visible confirmation containing the entered name after Save. Use the provided Material UI design system.
acceptance: Name and email inputs have accessible labels.
Save displays confirmation using the entered name.
Cancel restores initial values.
The form is usable at both target widths.

tasks.prompt: Build a billing summary with three invoices, totals, and a Pay action for each unpaid invoice. Preserve invoice identifiers and use the provided Material UI design system.
acceptance: All three provided invoices and totals remain visible.
Pay changes the selected invoice status only.
The summary preserves readable mobile layout.
Buttons use governed appearance props.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact Save action with roughly 13px internal spacing and room above it. Choose the closest existing size treatment, retain its label, and show confirmation on activation.
acceptance: The existing compact size treatment supplies internal spacing.
Margin can provide room above the action.
Save is keyboard accessible and displays confirmation.
No Button padding override is introduced.

tasks.prompt: Build a prominent red Delete account action and a confirmation dialog. Keep the provided destructive color family, support Cancel, and show a completion state after confirmation.
acceptance: The action uses the existing destructive component treatment.
Cancel closes the dialog without completing deletion.
Confirmation displays the completion state.
Destructive emphasis remains visible in both color schemes.

tasks.prompt: Build a responsive two-panel layout using Box, Stack or current Grid APIs. Panels stack on mobile and sit side by side on desktop. Use responsive theme spacing and a semantic surface color.
acceptance: Panels stack at the mobile target and are adjacent at the desktop target.
Spacing uses theme-aware values.
The semantic surface remains readable in light and dark modes.
Legal Box and Stack styling is retained.

tasks.prompt: Build a labeled consent checkbox and a Submit action disabled until consent is checked. Use the existing Button treatments and keep state styling consistent with the theme.
acceptance: Submit is disabled before consent.
Checking consent enables Submit.
Keyboard activation works when enabled.
Disabled styling remains discernible without restyling Button.

tasks.prompt: Add a reusable promo Button variant for the existing brand palette. Make two campaign actions consume the variant. Update the permitted theme and TypeScript augmentation files, preserving all existing treatments.
acceptance: The new variant uses the existing brand token.
Both campaign actions consume the same variant.
Existing variant definitions remain intact.
The augmentation type-checks and light/dark brand intent survives.

tasks.prompt: Build a status indicator using an sx theme callback whose background derives from the supplied runtime status and theme. Keep its accessible status text synchronized with the selected status.
acceptance: All provided statuses display the matching text.
Changing status updates the indicator.
Theme-based callback styling is not rewritten as a literal color.
Unresolved styling is reported as coverage uncertainty.

tasks.prompt: Build a records table using the supplied MUI X Community DataGrid. Display the provided records, allow sorting by amount, support row selection with a visible selected-record summary, and paginate within a bounded container. Preserve the supplied design system.
acceptance: All fixture records remain reachable through pagination; do not require all virtualized rows in DOM simultaneously.
Sorting by amount produces correct ascending and descending values.
Keyboard selection updates the visible selected-record summary.
Grid and container have nonzero measured dimensions and remain usable at both target widths.

tasks.prompt: Build an appointment date and time form using the supplied MUI X Community DatePicker and TimePicker. Show the entered values after confirmation and reject dates outside the supplied range. Use the fixture LocalizationProvider and adapter.
acceptance: Date and time values can be edited with keyboard and picker controls.
Out-of-range dates cannot be confirmed; errors remain perceivable.
Confirmation shows the independently expected chosen date and time.
Open, accept and cancel preserve correct value state; desktop/mobile behavior is controlled explicitly, not inferred from viewport alone.

tasks.prompt: Build a revenue chart using the supplied MUI X Community BarChart and quarterly data. Include series labels and an inspectable tooltip, and make it readable in the compact viewport. Use approved fixture treatments when improving presentation.
acceptance: Rendered bar marks and labels represent all supplied values without fabricated data.
Legend or equivalent visible labeling preserves the identity of both series.
Hover and keyboard navigation expose correct tooltip values.
Axes remain readable at both target widths after layout settles; axis font metrics use dedicated supported APIs.
Fixture-approved default chart colors or independently validated channel-specific treatments are used; sx palette paths are not suggested for dedicated CSS-color props.

tasks.prompt: Build a project navigator using the supplied MUI X Community RichTreeView and item hierarchy. Support expansion and selection and display the selected item label while preserving the design system.
acceptance: IDs and parent/child relationships match the pristine fixture.
Expand and collapse reveal and hide the correct descendants.
Keyboard traversal and selection update the visible selected-item label.
No items disappear during styling correction; the navigator works at both target widths.
